bio: In the heart of the Núñez district, right next to the train station, there is a restaurant with a relaxed atmosphere that is gaining popularity and always has customers waiting. It offers a comfortable and bright dining room, with well-set tables (all of them have their own little lamp, which adds a romantic touch), a bar where you can also eat and the open kitchen at the back. This is the most lively part, as there’s also a large communal table there which doubles as a serving space. The couple in charge, chefs Clara Corso and Lucas Canga, like to define it as a ‘neo-bistro’ where they serve up traditional food with a modern twist, designed for sharing. Dishes include the ham and cheese tartlet, a pleasant trout salad, the hearty ribeye steak and marrow, the delicious combination of pears, white chocolate and tonka bean. The round tables placed at the entrance are reminiscent of Parisian terraces!
